summary: Scheduled Saturday check: the relevant arXiv new-listing pages still pointed to the Friday, 31 July 2026 batch, so no newly posted qualifying heavy-ion or physics-AI/ML papers were identified beyond the already archived 2026-07-31 selection. The current scientific priorities remain STAR hypernuclei production in RHIC isobars, a constrained physics-informed CGC nuclear dipole extraction, and cautiously useful AI/ML workflow or benchmark papers for heavy-ion and HEP transfer.
strongest_paper: No newly posted qualifying paper in the August 1 Saturday check; see 2026-07-31 for the latest full selection.
top_takeaway: No fresh Saturday arXiv batch was available. The latest valid selection remains the July 31 report, led by STAR hypernuclei production and the physics-informed CGC dipole-amplitude extraction.

carried_forward_highlights.title: Probing (Hyper)Nuclei Wave Functions and Production Mechanisms in sqrt(sNN)=200 GeV Isobar Collisions at RHIC
carried_forward_highlights.abstract: STAR reports centrality-dependent hypernuclei and light-nuclei production in 200 GeV Ru+Ru and Zr+Zr collisions, with ratios favoring realistic non-Gaussian coalescence wave functions over simple thermal expectations.

carried_forward_highlights.title: Unbiased Data-Driven Determination of the Nuclear Dipole Amplitude in the Color Glass Condensate
carried_forward_highlights.authors_short: Si-Wei Dai, Haowu Duan, Long-Gang Pang, Guang-You Qin, Shu-Yi Wei, Han-Zhong Zhang, Wenbin Zhao
carried_forward_highlights.abstract: The paper embeds collinearly improved BK evolution and positivity constraints into a neural extraction of the Pb dipole amplitude from forward-hadron and coherent J/psi photoproduction data.

carried_forward_highlights.title: CLVisc Agent for autonomous relativistic hydrodynamics studies
carried_forward_highlights.authors_short: Qi Wang, Long-Gang Pang, Shi Pu, Xin-Nian Wang
carried_forward_highlights.abstract: The paper demonstrates an LLM-agent workflow for operating CLVisc, running hydrodynamic scans, comparing outputs, and producing figures for eta/s and O+O case studies.
